snippet.title: Roll Back Home - Trailer
snippet.description:
Roll the lost ball through underground mazes full of unique physics riddles - a roller coaster ride back home!
http://dawnofplay.com/rollbackhome/

Nominated "BEST UPCOMING GAME" at IMGA 2014.

Roll Back Home is a sketch-art action game, full of puzzles and adventure. Tilt to roll and jump with the lost ball through underground mazes full of mysterious riddles. Swing on large rams to smash walls, ride barrels to avoid being crushed and defy gravity, all to escape the dangers within the treacherous underground sewers. Presented in a sketched and animated flip book.

Features:
- Tilt to roll and jump
- Bounce and think through unique physics riddles
- Ride a mine cart, swing big rams, roll on barrels, defy gravity and more

Awards::
 ★ "Best Upcoming Game" nomination ★ The 10th IMGA 2014

Song: "Warthog"
by Otso "Ozoh" Haavisto
https://soundcloud.com/redapricorn
